拉克丝收到一封来自法师的求助信，夜深时动身却走进了搜魔人的圈套。在搜魔人的眼中，拉克珊娜·冕卫暗中包庇甚至帮助法师，这个行为严重背叛了德玛西亚以及冕卫家族，现在他们要清理门户，让拉克丝的悲惨下场被全德玛西亚人看见。

Lux receives a letter from a mage begging for help. Late at night, she sets out alone—only to walk straight into a Mageseeker trap.
In the eyes of the Mageseekers, Luxanna Crownguard has secretly sheltered, and even aided, mages. To them, this is a grave betrayal of Demacia and House Crownguard. Now, they intend to purge this disgrace from their ranks—and make sure all of Demacia sees Lux’s tragic fate.
